stem:
The figures shown each have a set of parallel lines intersected by a transversal.

Based on the figures, what are the measures x, y, and z in degrees?
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box in the table. Each answer may be used more than once. Not all answers will be used.
response_template:
Angle Measures
Unknown   Value
x          [blank_1]
y          [blank_2]
z          [blank_3]
visual_elements: Four geometric figures showing sets of parallel lines intersected by a transversal, with angles labeled as follows: 45°, 135°, 45°, 68°, 22°, 112°, 68°, 48°, 42°, 132°, 48°, 30°, x, y, z, all with right angles marked at intersections.
notes: The problem requires identifying angle values (x, y, z) and dragging the correct numerical degree measurements into the corresponding blanks.
